refresh_order: Configuration setters store the new geometry or seven output values before calling refresh_components.
ObjectModel::refresh_components requires explicit profile, assigns refresh_layout result to root component_counts before walking objects.

Every object whose type!=7 is visited in vector/list order; inactive type7 placeholders are skipped. Empty active objects still receive MeshStorage refresh, whose zero allocation counts make both container calls no-op.
Preserving storage uses independent allocated counts/arity, retains linear direct prefixes with unknown-tail accounting, and calls descriptor allocators without clear or replacement default fills.
No boundary reconstruction or scientific finalization is introduced by configuration refresh. The importer leaves finalization_pending explicit.

Invalid arithmetic/extents and allocation failures remain an explicitly bounded portable difference: checked exceptions can stop after configuration/table mutation. This does not emulate arbitrary native overflow or resource failure.

unknown_tail_consumers.replay: keyword_import_replay known_numbers writes values only through each buffer initialized-prefix; later entries become JSONnull and prefix lengths are emitted. It does not report placeholder0 as an original value.
unknown_tail_consumers.selected_importer: RZ and ELMCON write through spans only after fresh replacement allocation, whose direct buffers are initialized; configuration refresh itself does not read unknown direct values.
unknown_tail_consumers.boundary_path: finalize_connectivity reads connectivity. In the selected preserving refresh, element allocation count and allocated arity stay fixed, so connectivity byte length does not grow; a later ELMCON replaces and writes it before finalization. No newly introduced unknown-connectivity consumer was found in this integration.
unknown_tail_consumers.public_API_limit: MeshStorage still exposes raw spans and does not enforce knownness on every read. Downstream scientific consumers must honor initialized-prefix metadata; arbitrary calls outside the selected importer can otherwise read safe placeholders as if meaningful. Writes beyond a known prefix conservatively remain unknown until richer write tracking exists.
unknown_tail_consumers.mask_limit: A contiguous prefix represents current append/shrink unknownness. Sparse newly established values would require richer validity tracking; the review does not claim that extension.
